entries.title: RBI payment data localisation
entries.summary: AtliQ must ensure that payment system data included in Client Data is stored only in India to comply with RBI data localisation requirements.
entries.quote: AtliQ acknowledges that Client Data may include payment system data subject to RBI data localisation requirements, and shall ensure that such data is stored only in India.

relatedClauses.quote: Client Data" means all data, including transaction data and merchant data, provided by or on behalf of PayTrack.
These obligations survive for five (5) years following termination, and indefinitely in respect of Client Data.

entries.notes: Clause 7.3 specifies that confidentiality and location obligations survive indefinitely in respect of Client Data.

entries.title: Information security and RBI outsourcing compliance
entries.summary: AtliQ must comply with PayTrack's information security policies and written RBI guidelines on outsourcing of IT services.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall comply with PayTrack's information security policies and the RBI guidelines on outsourcing of IT services as communicated by PayTrack in writing.

entries.title: DPDP Act and RBI data compliance
entries.summary: AtliQ must process personal data in Client Data only on PayTrack's documented instructions and in compliance with the DPDP Act 2023, IT Act 2000, and applicable RBI directions.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall process personal data comprised in Client Data only on PayTrack's documented instructions and in compliance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, the Information Technology Act, 2000 and applicable RBI directions.

relatedClauses.quote: Client Data" means all data, including transaction data and merchant data, provided by or on behalf of PayTrack.

entries.title: Data breach notification window
entries.summary: AtliQ must notify PayTrack of any data breach within 24 hours of discovery and cooperate with reporting to CERT-In or the RBI.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall notify PayTrack of any data breach within twenty-four (24) hours of becoming aware of it, and shall cooperate with PayTrack in any reporting to CERT-In or the RBI.

entries.title: Data compliance audit rights
entries.summary: AtliQ must permit PayTrack and its regulators to audit compliance with data protection obligations on reasonable notice.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall permit PayTrack and its regulators to audit its compliance with this Clause 12 on reasonable notice.

entries.title: Staff non-solicitation
entries.summary: Mutual restriction on soliciting employees engaged in the Services during the term of the agreement and for 12 months thereafter.
entries.quote: Neither Party shall solicit for employment the other Party's employees engaged in the Services during the term and for twelve (12) months thereafter.
entries.notes: Mutual routine staff non-solicitation restricted to employees engaged in the services.

entries.title: Business continuity plan maintenance
entries.summary: AtliQ must maintain a business continuity plan appropriate to the Services provided.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall maintain a business continuity plan appropriate to the Services.
